title: Counting functions on the root-of-unity cube
statement: Let $K$ be a finite field, let $\omega \in K$ with $\omega \ne 1$, and let $n \in \bbn$. Writing $\{1,\omega\}^n$ for the set of vectors $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to K$ each of whose coordinates equals $1$ or $\omega$, the number of functions $\{1,\omega\}^n \to K$ is \[ \abs{K}^{\,2^n}. \]
replaced:
If $\omega \ne 1$ and $K$ is finite, the number of functions $\{1,\omega\}^n \to K$ is
$\abs{K}^{2^n}$.
